description: Every plain HTTP fetch of bank.gov.ua during this run returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — HTML pages (/ua/statistic/supervision-statist) and the OpenData API (/NBUStatService/v1/statdirectory/basindbank?json) alike.

result.result_summary: 0 successful fetches of bank.gov.ua; content confirmed to exist only via search-engine indexing (including 2026-dated items).

why_it_matters: Collection design must assume browser-like headers or a headless browser for the NBU domain, and should prefer the data.gov.ua mirrors where equivalent datasets exist. This is a bot-defence hypothesis, NOT evidence the pages are dead.

description: No canonical URL was recovered for a per-bank statutory financial-statements landing page (individual licensed banks' IFRS statements republished by the NBU). Searches returned only aggregate/grouped datasets and the reporting-rules announcement.

result.result_summary: Aggregate data located; per-institution statement index not located in this run.

why_it_matters: Per-bank statements are the highest-value A1 artefact. It may sit behind the Unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина СФЗ) portal rather than on bank.gov.ua, which would move part of this cell outside the NBU domain.

description: The dedicated NBU webpage aggregating ownership-structure disclosures by non-bank financial institutions is announced in a news item, but its canonical hub URL could not be extracted because the news page could not be fetched.

result.result_summary: Announcement located; hub URL unknown.

why_it_matters: Ownership/beneficial-owner data for payment institutions is a key A1 attribute for the payments half of the run scope.

description: A search result pointed to https://new.bank.gov.ua/ua/statistic/supervision-statist, but the hostname failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND).

result.result_summary: new.bank.gov.ua does not resolve; likely a staging host that was indexed and later retired, or is internal-only.

why_it_matters: Collection configs must not be pointed at new.bank.gov.ua; use bank.gov.ua. Worth re-checking later in case NBU migrates to a redesigned site on that host.

description: No RSS/Atom feed for the NBU press service was identified during this run.

result.result_summary: Press releases appear reachable only via the /ua/news/all and /en/news/all listing pages.

why_it_matters: Without a feed, press-release monitoring requires HTML crawling of a bot-defended host, raising collection cost and fragility.

description: None of the four state banks appears to run a Western-style 'Investor Relations' section with an IR calendar, results presentations and analyst contacts. Disclosure is split between statutory issuer pages (звітність емітента / регулярна інформація) and the MoF shareholder pages.

result.result_summary: Searches in uk and en for 'investor relations' on oschadbank.ua, privatbank.ua and ukrgasbank.com returned news and statutory pages, not an IR hub.

why_it_matters: Collection design must target statutory disclosure pages plus MoF, not an IR RSS/calendar; expect annual PDF drops rather than quarterly investor decks.

description: No canonical Sense Bank disclosure/reporting page URL was surfaced by either uk or en searches; only a raw XLSX under /uploads/ and third-party mirrors (SMIDA, MoF).

result.result_summary: Two uk queries incl. a site-scoped one returned help-centre and product pages only.

why_it_matters: Sense Bank is a privatisation candidate and a systemically important bank — a coverage hole on the freshest state-owned issuer.

description: No issuer-hosted eurobond/LPN investor page (offering circulars, noteholder notices, RNS-style announcements) was found for Oschadbank; only a Cbonds record and law-firm mandate descriptions of the 2015-16 LPN restructuring.

result.result_summary: en query on eurobond/LPN disclosure returned no oschadbank.ua investor-notice page.

why_it_matters: Eurobond documentation is the highest-grade IR material; if it exists it likely sits with the LSE/Irish Stock Exchange listing venue or the trustee, not the bank site — needs a dedicated follow-up pass.

description: Three targets could not be fetched in this pass: mof.gov.ua state-banks page (403), oschadbank.ua issuer-reporting page (redirect loop), en.privatbank.ua (DNS ENOTFOUND).

result.result_summary: All three are treated as bot-defended or host-naming issues, not dead.

why_it_matters: Deterministic verification and a browser-headers/headless fetcher are required before any of these is scored as unreachable.

description: 'PrivatBank' is a heavily noisy term in English: DZ PRIVATBANK (Luxembourg/Switzerland), AS PrivatBank (Latvia) and Wiener Privatbank all dominate en-language results alongside the Ukrainian bank.

result.result_summary: Half of the top en results for the seed query were non-Ukrainian entities.

why_it_matters: All queries and any automated harvesting must be domain-scoped (privatbank.ua) or qualified with 'Ukraine'/'ПриватБанк' to avoid contamination.

description: nabu.ua (Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України) returned HTTP 429 on both the homepage and the sitemap page within this run.

result.result_summary: No member roster URL confirmed for the association whose members reportedly hold >95% of banking-system assets. Indexed pages (karta-sayta.html, struktura-nabu.html, zagalna-informatsiya.html, ru.html) show the site is live and multilingual; this is a rate-limit/bot defence, NOT evidence the site is dead.

why_it_matters: NABU is the single most important banking-membership pointer in this cell; without its roster the banking actor population rests on АУБ and УКБС alone.

description: fintechua.org (УАФІК/UAFIC), both the uk root and the /en mirror, returned effectively empty HTML to a plain fetch.

result.result_summary: Navigation, member list and news routes could not be enumerated without a JS-capable client. Existence and activity are corroborated independently (Diia Business card, EDRPOU 42031209, 2025 fintech study covered by trade media).

why_it_matters: The fintech membership layer is the part of the population least visible elsewhere; collection here will require a headless browser rather than simple HTTP.

description: ukbs.org.ua (Український кредитно-банківський союз) failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND) on the single attempt made.

result.result_summary: Association is well attested (est. 1994, ~92 member institutions, EDRPOU 21573585) and the domain appears in search results, so this is treated as unverified — one failed resolution is not a verdict that the site is gone.

why_it_matters: УКБС covers smaller and regional institutions that the larger associations may not list; losing it would bias the population toward large banks.

description: The cell brief names 'UCAB' as a banking/payments association.

result.result_summary: No banking or payments association matching 'UCAB' was found in uk or en searching. The established Ukrainian body using that acronym (ucab.ua) is the Ukrainian Agribusiness Club — an agriculture association, out of scope. The intended target is most likely УКБС (Український кредитно-банківський союз) or УАФІК.

why_it_matters: Prevents wasted crawl budget on an out-of-scope agriculture domain and redirects it to УКБС/УАФІК.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for an official register of self-regulatory organisations (СРО) for financial-services / payment-market participants.

result.result_summary: Found the legal basis only (Art. 20 of the law on financial services defining СРО, and the historical Нацкомфінпослуг registration mandate). No live, published SRO register for the banking/payments segment was located; the NSSMC (НКЦПФР) SRO regime applies to capital markets, not payments.

why_it_matters: Confirms that in UA banking/payments there is no formal SRO layer to enumerate — membership associations are voluntary, so no single roster is exhaustive and multiple associations must be unioned.

description: Searched in English for a European Banking Federation page listing Ukrainian associate members.

result.result_summary: EBF is confirmed to unite 33 national banking associations, but no page confirming a Ukrainian association's associate membership was found in results. Recorded as unconfirmed rather than negative.

why_it_matters: An EBF/WSBI associate-member listing would be an independent third-party validation of which UA association is the recognised national body.

description: Searches in uk and en for Ukrainian media publishing PSP/acquiring volume rankings analogous to bank profit league tables returned only bank-centric rankings (Minfin, Forbes, Mind, Opendatabot). Payments-side results coverage appears scattered across trade press (psm7.com) and NBU-derived news items rather than any recurring media ranking.

result.result_summary: No recurring Ukrainian media 'PSP/acquirer profit or volume ranking' identified in this pass.

why_it_matters: For the payments half of sector=both, media cannot be relied on as an aggregator; PSP financials will have to come from regulator statistics or company filings rather than from a media digest.

description: Candidate URLs were assembled from search results and site structure; no page in this slice was individually fetched and confirmed by me, and no RSS/feed endpoint was confirmed for any outlet. Paywall/registration status for Forbes.ua, Mind.ua, NV and Interfax full feeds is inferred, not observed.

result.result_summary: All URLs are hypotheses pending the deterministic liveness pass; feed availability unknown.

why_it_matters: Collection method choices (RSS vs crawl) and cost estimates for paywalled outlets cannot be finalised until liveness and feed discovery run.

description: Delo.ua surfaced alongside delo.net.ua in results and the search snippet resolved partly to an unrelated encyclopaedic entry; which domain is the live Ekonomika+ business outlet was not resolved.

result.result_summary: Delo identity/domain unresolved.

why_it_matters: Scheduling a crawl against the wrong domain wastes budget and can silently miss a mid-tier outlet.

description: Several of these outlets (FinClub, RBC-Ukraine) publish parallel ru-language editions, and the run's language scope is uk/en only, so ru-language duplicate coverage was not searched systematically.

result.result_summary: ru editions noted incidentally (finclub.net/ru/, rbc.ua/rus/) but not scouted.

why_it_matters: Deduplication logic will need to treat ru/uk editions of the same item as one story, and some archival depth exists only in the ru edition.

description: No evidence found of a dedicated, publicly documented API endpoint at Opendatabot or Vkursi that filters specifically for payment institutions / payment service providers as a class (as opposed to generic USREOU + KVED filtering).

result.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for Opendatabot/Vkursi API and payment-company data returned only generic company-lookup and financial-statement endpoints; sector filtering appears to be user-side via KVED codes.

why_it_matters: Payment-sector actor enumeration will have to be built by joining aggregator data to the NBU's own register of payment infrastructure participants rather than obtained ready-made from an aggregator.

description: The state of ЄДР bulk open data is in flux: coverage indicates access was restricted from 2022 and reported restored in January 2026, with publication on data.gov.ua described as still in progress and defence/strategic entities withheld.

result.result_summary: Dataset page exists on data.gov.ua; multiple secondary sources describe restoration and weekly updates, but actual current file availability was not fetched or confirmed in this pass.

why_it_matters: The whole cell's cheapest bulk channel may be partially available; the pipeline must degrade gracefully to commercial aggregators (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity, Vkursi) when the bulk dump is incomplete.

description: No Ukrainian-language equivalent found for a free, open, bulk-downloadable register of beneficial owners specifically for banks; UBO data appears only inside the ЄДР and inside paid aggregator dossiers.

result.result_summary: Searches for кінцевий бенефіціарний власник in the context of banks returned aggregator dossier pages and policy news, not a standalone open UBO dataset for the financial sector.

why_it_matters: Ownership tracking for Ukrainian banks will depend on ЄДР extracts plus NBU-published ownership structures rather than a purpose-built open UBO feed.

description: The NAIS (ДП «НАІС») open-data publication path was named in secondary coverage but its exact download URL was not located; the candidate is recorded at the organisation's root domain only.

result.result_summary: Secondary sources say ЄДР open data is published on the Ministry of Justice site and by SE NAIS; no direct file listing URL was retrieved.

why_it_matters: A second, official mirror of the ЄДР bulk data would materially de-risk the pipeline; the exact path still needs to be found.

description: All four commercial aggregators in this cell (YouControl, Opendatabot, Clarity Project, Vkursi) gate financial statements and bulk/API access behind paid tariffs.

result.result_summary: Pricing pages exist for Opendatabot and Clarity Project; Vkursi and YouControl advertise API and subscription tiers.

why_it_matters: The archive value of this cell — recovering filings after issuer sites go offline — is real but requires budget and licence terms permitting analytical reuse; scraping would breach ToS.

description: No dedicated national web archive for the Ukrainian web ('Архів українського вебу') was found. Searching the exact Ukrainian phrase against NBUV returned only the Ukrainika electronic library and IRBIS catalogues, with a generic statement about archiving online resources but no discoverable web-archive interface or crawl index.

result.result_summary: Ukraine appears to lack a public national web archive; the Internet Archive plus SUCHO are effectively the substitute infrastructure.

why_it_matters: It means there is no sovereign fallback for .ua disclosure continuity — the entire pre-2022 baseline for this cell depends on foreign-hosted archives, which raises single-point-of-failure and coverage-bias risk.

description: No archive-focused source was found covering Crimean/Donbas LEGACY entities specifically — i.e. the institutions that took over the branch networks of Ukrainian banks after 2014 (e.g. Crimea-based successor banks). Ukrainian-language searching surfaced the NBU/DGF exit registers for Ukrainian banks but nothing that archives the disclosure of the occupying-side successor institutions.

result.result_summary: Coverage of occupied-territory successor institutions is absent from this slice.

why_it_matters: Half the 'legacy entity' question — what happened to the branch estate and payment infrastructure after Ukrainian banks exited — is invisible without it, and those entities are also sanctions-relevant, which constrains any collection.

description: I had no established Ukrainian vocabulary for web archiving of corporate disclosure specifically: terms like 'веб-архів', 'знімок сторінки', 'архівна копія сайту' returned generic or unrelated results, and Ukrainian-language searches did not surface any archiving service or project aimed at financial-sector websites.

result.result_summary: Local-language terminology for this cell's core concept is thin, so uk-language search recall for archiving infrastructure is inherently poor; uk searches were productive only for the REGISTER side (НБУ/ФГВФО/SMIDA), not the ARCHIVE side.

why_it_matters: Future runs should search the register/liquidation vocabulary in Ukrainian and the archiving vocabulary in English, rather than expecting both in one language.

description: archive.today/archive.ph is documented as serving bot challenges to automated clients and has no official API. I did not attempt a fetch, so its accessibility here is a hypothesis, not a verdict.

result.result_summary: Treat archive.ph as manual-only until a deterministic pass tests it.

why_it_matters: If archive.ph is unusable at scale, IA becomes the sole automatable archive and its robots-based exclusions become an unmitigated blind spot.

description: No archived-disclosure source was found for Ukrainian PSPs / non-bank payment institutions (e.g. Portmone, EasyPay, City24, IBox, Fondy). Searching for archived Ukrainian PSP investor/disclosure pages surfaced only bank material; PSPs are mostly private LLCs with no statutory issuer disclosure, so SMIDA does not cover them.

result.result_summary: PSP-side archival continuity is unaddressed in this slice despite sector=both.

why_it_matters: Payments-side history (fee schedules, network partners, ownership announcements) exists only on the PSPs' own sites, making it uniquely vulnerable and uniquely dependent on proactive Wayback save-page-now capture.

description: No Diebold Nixdorf or NCR/NCR Atleos press release announcing an ATM or branch-automation contract with a named Ukrainian bank (Oschadbank, PrivatBank or others) surfaced in English-language search.

result.result_summary: Search returned only global Diebold Nixdorf/NCR strategy coverage, an unrelated FOREX go-live release, and SEC filings — nothing Ukraine-specific. This is a search negative, not evidence that no such deal or release exists; the OEM newsrooms and atmmarketplace hubs were not exhaustively paged.

why_it_matters: Global ATM OEM engagement in Ukraine is a core question for this cell. If the OEMs genuinely do not publish Ukrainian wins, the estate must be reconstructed from Prozorro award records and local service companies instead of vendor PR.

description: No Ukrainian-language search terms were established for the global ATM OEMs' local entities. Queries mixing 'Diebold Nixdorf'/'NCR' with Ukrainian words were not run in this pass, and the transliterations ('Дібольд Ніксдорф', 'ЕН-СІ-АР', 'Ей-Ті-Ем груп') are untested guesses.

result.result_summary: The one attempted transliteration probe ('Ей Ті Ем') returned nothing relevant — only bank ATM-location maps, i.e. the term is heavily noisy in Ukrainian.

why_it_matters: Local-language coverage is mandatory and the ATM-hardware sub-segment currently rests on English sources plus one local service company (Printec Ukraine). Ukrainian legal-entity names are needed to query the state register and local press.

description: The Ukrainian terms 'банкомат' and 'POS-термінал' are dominated by consumer-facing content — bank branch/ATM location maps, merchant acquiring sales pages and PRRO retail shops — rather than supplier or procurement information.

result.result_summary: Both the POS-supplier and Printec queries returned mostly privatbank.ua/map, pumb.ua/map, universalbank.com.ua/map and terminal e-shops.

why_it_matters: Any automated collection on these terms needs vendor-name or procurement-vocabulary anchors ('постачальник', 'закупівля', 'ДК 021', 'впровадження', 'сервісне обслуговування') or it will drown in retail noise.

description: No evidence found of BPC Banking Technologies (SmartVista), OpenWay (Way4) or Temenos engagements with Ukrainian banks.

result.result_summary: The combined English query surfaced only Tietoevry/UPC material; no BPC, OpenWay or Temenos Ukraine announcement appeared. Not searched in Ukrainian ('Смарт Віста', 'Вей4', 'Теменос') in this pass.

why_it_matters: These three are the most likely international card-processing/core-banking suppliers in the CIS/CEE region; their absence or presence in Ukraine materially shapes the competitive map. Currently unresolved rather than negative.

description: No card-personalisation or card-issuance vendor announcement (IDEMIA, Thales/Gemalto, Giesecke+Devrient) naming a Ukrainian bank was found.

result.result_summary: The English query returned only global metal-card rankings, an Egypt biometric-card contest and a Madagascar ID contract — nothing Ukrainian. Ukrainian-language equivalents ('персоналізація карток', 'виробництво платіжних карток') were not queried in this pass.

why_it_matters: Card manufacturing/personalisation is a recurring capex line for issuers and is normally announced by the supplier, not the bank; a blind spot here leaves issuance-side infrastructure unmapped.

description: No Ukrainian in-country distributor of Ingenico, PAX or Verifone POS hardware was identified.

result.result_summary: The query returned only North American and Western European distributors (POSDATA, DCCSupply, paymentdiscounter). The Ukrainian-language part of the query did not pull local distributor pages.

why_it_matters: The terminal distribution channel determines who actually supplies acquiring banks in Ukraine. Without it, the POS hardware supply chain must be inferred from bank acquiring pages, reseller catalogues and Prozorro awards.

description: None of the listed candidate URLs were fetched or liveness-checked in this pass — all were recorded from search-result metadata and snippets.

result.result_summary: URLs are provided with confidence scores only; no claim is made that any is reachable. Access-status fields (e.g. suspected paywalls at youcontrol.com.ua and finclub.net, suspected registration wall at playtender.com.ua) are hypotheses.

why_it_matters: A downstream deterministic verification pass must confirm liveness and access; a 403 or timeout on any of these should be treated as bot defence, not as a dead source.

description: No TED notice specifically for banking or payment services in Ukraine was surfaced by search; the only concrete Ukraine-related TED notice found was for security services to the EU Delegation to Ukraine (notice 151645-2025).

result.result_summary: TED is confirmed as a relevant channel, but no banking/payments Ukraine notice was actually located in this pass. Requires a CPV-filtered search on the TED site itself.

why_it_matters: Prevents overstating EU-funded banking procurement volume for Ukraine; the channel is a hypothesis until a CPV 66xxxxxx + Ukraine query returns hits.

description: Searches on Mintsyfra/Diia payment procurement returned platform-administration and Diia.ID tenders, but no lot explicitly for 'платіжний шлюз' / 'еквайринг' inside state e-services.

result.result_summary: The Diia payment-rail procurement, if it exists, may be embedded inside broader IT administration contracts or handled by a bank under a non-procurement arrangement.

why_it_matters: The commercial terms of payment acceptance in Diia are strategically important and appear not to be exposed as a standalone tender — a structural blind spot rather than a search failure.

description: URLs for dasu.gov.ua and the center.diia.gov.ua library article were not fetched in this pass; the Diia slug in particular was transcribed from a search result.

result.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence rather than asserted as reachable.

why_it_matters: Avoids a false liveness claim ahead of the deterministic verification pass.

description: AMCU has published notices about changes to the publication of appeals-body decisions, implying the decision corpus may not be consistently or fully published on amcu.gov.ua over time.

result.result_summary: Appeal decisions are best collected via the tender record in ProZorro or via aggregators (Clarity) rather than assuming a complete AMCU archive.

why_it_matters: A collection routine pointed only at amcu.gov.ua would silently under-collect disputes on banking lots.

description: A direct fetch of the RBI investor reports hub (https://www.rbinternational.com/en/investors/reports.html) returned report categories (semi-annual, annual, quarterly, regulatory disclosures) and headline metrics, but no mention of Ukraine on the landing page itself — only repeated 'excl. Russia' framing.

result.result_summary: Ukraine-specific figures are not exposed on the IR landing page; they live inside the report PDFs and the XLSM results file, so the landing page alone is not a usable extraction target.

why_it_matters: Collection must go one level deeper (into the PDF/XLSM artefacts) rather than scraping the IR index; a shallow crawler would wrongly conclude RBI does not report Ukraine.

description: No named 'Ukraine segment' was found in Crédit Agricole S.A. group-level reporting; searches surfaced only the Ukrainian subsidiary's own site as the source of Ukraine P&L and ratios.

result.result_summary: Crédit Agricole's Ukraine disclosure is subsidiary-published (credit-agricole.ua press centre + documents page), not parent-segment-published.

why_it_matters: The cell's premise (Ukraine data hiding inside Vienna/Budapest/Paris group reports) holds strongly for RBI, OTP and ProCredit but only weakly for Paris; collection design must differ per parent.

description: The cell brief names a 'Pyrkal/Bank Pivdenny-type minority' foreign-stake tier. Searching in Ukrainian for Bank Pivdenny management reports and foreign shareholders did not return a foreign parent group publishing a Ukraine segment or country annex.

result.result_summary: No foreign-parent IR channel identified for Bank Pivdenny; only local/media profiles were found.

why_it_matters: For minority-foreign-stake banks the group-disclosure channel appears absent, so this tier must be covered by local statutory disclosure (NBU, SMIDA, bank site) instead — a different collection design.

description: No Ukrainian-language equivalent of parent-group 'segment reporting' vocabulary was found in use on parent IR sites; Ukrainian search terms only reach subsidiary-level documents (річний звіт, фінансова звітність, звіт про управління).

result.result_summary: Parent-group Ukraine annexes exist only in EN (and HU/DE for OTP/RBI/ProCredit domestic filings); uk-language search cannot reach them.

why_it_matters: A uk-only crawl systematically misses the group channel, and an en-only crawl misses the local statutory channel — both language passes are structurally required for this cell.

description: The intuitive domain bankvostok.com.ua did not surface as Bank Vostok's live disclosure site; all real documents resolve to vstbank.ua (and a legacy content host content.vostok.bank), consistent with a rebrand to «ВСТ БАНК».

result.result_summary: Searching the assumed domain returned unrelated banks (PrivatBank, Industrialbank) plus vstbank.ua PDFs.

why_it_matters: A collector keyed to bankvostok.com.ua would record a false dead source; the correct base domain must be vstbank.ua.

description: No successor institution to АКБ «Конкорд» was found. NBU revoked its licence on 01.08.2023 for AML violations and the Deposit Guarantee Fund completed liquidation on 05.05.2026. No evidence links Concord's business to Fintech Band/monobank or any other bank.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only liquidation coverage (NBU, DGF, media); no acquiring bank, no transferred portfolio, no archived disclosure page.

why_it_matters: The cell brief names 'Concord successors' as a target; for source-scouting purposes that target does not exist as a live disclosure publisher and should be re-scoped to DGF liquidation records and web archives.

description: universalbank.com.ua (monobank's licensed bank) returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch of its financial-reports page.

result.result_summary: 403 Forbidden on https://www.universalbank.com.ua/financial-reports; the page is indexed in search and other pages on the domain are referenced normally.

why_it_matters: This is the single most important source in the cell. It must be treated as bot-defended-but-live and collected via a browser-based fetcher, not marked dead.

description: a-bank.com.ua/about/reports returned only a shell page titled «Регулярна інформація» with no document links in the HTML.

result.result_summary: Content is loaded client-side; document files are served through /backend/api/v1/pages/media/file?path=...

why_it_matters: A static-HTML crawler will silently collect zero A-Bank documents; headless rendering or direct use of the media API is required.

description: No consolidated investor-relations portal exists for Ukrainian domestic private banks. Each bank publishes under its own «розкриття інформації» / «фінансова звітність» heading with a different URL scheme, file-naming convention and CMS.

result.result_summary: Five banks examined used five different document path patterns (Drupal /sites/default/files, SparkFile CMS, backend media API, /docs/accounting/annual/{year}, /storage/files).

why_it_matters: Collection must be per-bank bespoke; only SMIDA/stockmarket.gov.ua offer a uniform fallback, and only for issuer-format filings.

description: The English concept 'investor relations' has no consistent Ukrainian counterpart on these banks' sites; the functional equivalents are «інформація для акціонерів та стейкхолдерів», «регульована інформація емітента» and «загальні збори акціонерів».

result.result_summary: Querying with IR-style English terms returned mostly PUMB (the only bank with a true EN IR section); local queries were required for all others.

why_it_matters: English-only discovery would have found roughly one of the ~15 disclosure pages in this cell; local-language querying is not optional here.

description: I found no evidence of a sector/KVED or 'banks only' filter within the SMIDA issuer database or the stockmarket.gov.ua participant index. The fetched /db/emitent page did not document search parameters, filters or URL query structure.

result.result_summary: Issuer enumeration for banking/payments will have to be done by joining EDRPOU codes from external registers (NBU licensed banks, payment-institution registers, ЄДР) against the issuer index, not by a native sector filter.

why_it_matters: Materially changes the collection design: the disclosure system is a confirmation and enrichment layer keyed by EDRPOU, not a self-serve sector screen.

description: The stockmarket.gov.ua open-data API index page states that data is available through 30 June 2021, matching the site's 'Опублікування регульованої інформації (до 30/06/2021)' archive label.

result.result_summary: The v1 API appears to be a historical archive; post-July-2021 regulated information appears to flow through the SMIDA /db/feed stream and authorised regulated-information publishers instead. I did not find a documented successor API.

why_it_matters: A pipeline built only on the v1 API would silently stop at mid-2021 and miss all recent bank filings.

description: Ukrainian-language searching for the register of 'осіб, які провадять діяльність з оприлюднення регульованої інформації' returned the legal framework (Положення z1307-23) and general descriptions, but I did not locate a public list page enumerating the licensed publishers.

result.result_summary: The existence of the role is confirmed by regulation; the enumerated register was not found in this pass.

why_it_matters: If issuers may publish via multiple authorised publishers, monitoring only SMIDA may leave gaps for some bank issuers.

description: stockmarket.gov.ua lists a 'Prospectuses' category in its participant navigation, but I did not find a documented direct URL for a searchable prospectus register, and searches for a bank bond prospectus register returned only procedural/administrative-service pages.

result.result_summary: Prospectus discovery is currently hypothesised to run through the stockmarket.gov.ua prospectus section, the State Register of Securities Issues and the /db/feed 'проспект' report type — none confirmed as a standalone register UI.

why_it_matters: Bond prospectuses are the richest single artefact for a bank's funding strategy and risk disclosures; an unresolved access path is a real gap.

description: stockmarket.gov.ua exposes /db/login and /registration/user; the login page states that general information about issuers, exchanges, traders and rating agencies is freely accessible while 'перегляд інформації' and the pre-30/06/2021 disclosure-subject area use authorisation forms.

result.result_summary: Most of the value appears public, but some views may require a free account. Not tested — I did not create an account.

why_it_matters: Collection design should assume an anonymous path first and flag any view that turns out to be account-gated rather than assuming the whole database is open.

description: Ukrainian-language searching linking the NSSMC disclosure system to payments companies (платіжні установи, фінансові компанії) surfaced no payments-specific disclosure pathway; results were dominated by banks and general corporate issuers.

result.result_summary: Non-bank payments firms in Ukraine are typically LLCs rather than joint-stock companies and so mostly fall outside issuer disclosure, unless they issue bonds.

why_it_matters: This cell should be treated as strong for banks and weak for pure payments actors; payments coverage must come from NBU/other registers.

description: Repeated Ukrainian-language searches for annual reports or financial statements published by Portmone, Fondy, EasyPay, IBOX, City24, LeoGaming or Maxi returned no company-published annual report or IR page.

result.result_summary: Search results surfaced only third-party comparison articles, marketing pages and the open-data reporting portal. No 'річний звіт' PDF or investor-relations section was found for any of these brands.

why_it_matters: The default assumption that licensed PSPs run investor-facing disclosure does not hold in Ukraine: apart from NovaPay, this layer is disclosure-silent and must be reconstructed from statutory filings and the regulator's register.

description: No press room or corporate press-release section was located for the 'Максі' / Maxi paysystems brand named in the cell scope.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian brand-plus-licence query returned nothing attributable to a Maxi payment operator; the brand may be defunct, renamed, or trading under a differently named legal entity.

why_it_matters: The actor name in the cell brief may be stale. Entity resolution must run off the NBU register rather than off brand names.

description: The NSSMC issuer-disclosure system (stockmarket.gov.ua / SMIDA) was probed as a route to regulated disclosure by bond-issuing payment groups, but no direct landing URL was confirmed in this run.

result.result_summary: The disclosure-portal query returned association and academic results instead; the portal itself was not reached, so it is recorded as an unconfirmed hypothesis rather than a candidate.

why_it_matters: For NovaPay Credit and any other PSP that issues public bonds, the securities-regulator disclosure system is the mandatory-filing channel and would be a high-value source; it needs a follow-up pass.

description: The direct downloadable file of the Register of Payment Infrastructure was not isolated to a single confirmed URL in this run.

result.result_summary: Search confirmed the register exists and is maintained under bank.gov.ua supervision pages, but the specific export endpoint was not pinned down; recorded at the section level with medium confidence.

why_it_matters: The register export is the backbone of the actor map for this cell; the exact endpoint should be resolved by a browsing pass before collection is automated.

description: Neither Visa nor Mastercard publishes Ukraine-specific volume, card-count or interchange disclosure. Ukraine-level scheme figures found in the press are consistently attributed to the NBU, not to the schemes.

result.result_summary: Searched in uk and en for Visa/Mastercard Ukraine results releases; only NBU-sourced share figures and generic marketing press surfaced.

why_it_matters: Scheme-level UA numbers must be sourced from the regulator, not from scheme IR; do not expect an earnings-style series from the international schemes.

description: No published annual report or audited operational report for UPC, UkrCard, TAS Link or the EasyPay processing entity was located on the open web; volume claims ('400M+ transactions/year') come from company marketing pages and third-party profiles.

result.result_summary: Searched in en and uk for processor annual reports/processing volumes; only marketing copy, LinkedIn/Crunchbase profiles and NBU designation notices found.

why_it_matters: Processing-volume estimates must be treated as vendor claims; audited numbers, if any, will only appear via SMIDA issuer filings for the PrJSC-form entities.

description: bank.gov.ua returned HTTP 403 on a direct statistics-page fetch, while its PDF assets and news pages are indexed and reachable in search results.

result.result_summary: WebFetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/statistic/sector-payment -> 403 Forbidden.

why_it_matters: The single most important source for this cell is bot-defended; collection must use a browser-grade client. This is a hypothesis of bot protection, not evidence the site is down.

description: The NBU-designated important operator 'ТОВ ЕЙСІ ДІСКІ ПРОЦЕСІНГ' was not conclusively mapped to a public consumer brand/domain during this pass; the EasyPay association is an inference.

result.result_summary: Registry-derived legal name found, but no confirmed corporate site.

why_it_matters: Prevents mis-attribution of processing volumes to the wrong brand.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for a DGF dataset presence on Ukraine's national open-data portal (data.gov.ua) covering banks in liquidation, payouts or asset sales. No DGF dataset page was surfaced by search; all results pointed back to fg.gov.ua HTML pages.

result.result_summary: Could not confirm any machine-readable DGF dataset on data.gov.ua. Not a verdict that none exists — search recall was the limit, and the portal was not queried directly.

why_it_matters: If no structured open-data feed exists, all DGF collection must be HTML scraping of article-style pages plus PDF parsing, which is fragile and raises the cost of the collection layer. Worth a direct check of data.gov.ua's own search before committing to a scraper-only design.

description: Two Prozorro.Sale pages (the bankrupt-bank asset-sales landing page and the open-data page) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on plain fetch, while the same URLs appear as normal indexed results in search.

result.result_summary: Recorded as bot-defended-but-presumed-live rather than dead. The specific open-data/API endpoint list for the ЦБД1 bankrupt-bank asset stream could therefore not be enumerated in this pass.

why_it_matters: Prozorro.Sale holds the lot-level auction outcomes that the DGF site only aggregates. Without confirming the API surface, the collection plan for asset-sale pricing remains unspecified. A browser-based or properly-headered fetch should be retried before any liveness verdict.

description: The DGF annual-report landing pages were identified (article URLs per year), but the direct file URLs of the attached PDF/XLS annual report and audited financial statements were not individually enumerated in this pass.

result.result_summary: Year-level article URLs captured for 2021-2025; per-file attachment URLs unresolved.

why_it_matters: The collection pipeline needs the attachment URL pattern (likely under /storage/files/) to fetch the actual financial statements rather than the wrapper page. A single fetch of one report article will resolve this.

description: IADI's respondent-level annual survey data — which would contain Ukraine's own answers on resolution powers, funding and coverage — is members-only; only summary findings are public.

result.result_summary: Public summaries usable; granular Ukraine record requires a membership or a research-access request.

why_it_matters: Peer benchmarking of the Ukrainian failed-bank regime will be coarse unless access is requested. This is an access-negotiation item, not a discovery failure.

description: No established Ukrainian-language term was found for a consolidated, cross-bank 'failed bank financial condition' dataset analogous to the US FDIC's failed-bank list with financials. The DGF's own vocabulary decomposes into per-process terms ('ліквідаційна маса', 'надходження', 'задоволення вимог кредиторів') rather than one dataset name.

result.result_summary: Searched with several constructed Ukrainian phrasings; only the per-process pages surfaced.

why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must target the process vocabulary, not a dataset name. Analysts expecting an FDIC-style single table will need to assemble it from the per-bank subdomains and the receipts/statistics articles.

description: The NBU no longer maintains its own Register of audit firms entitled to audit banks. Search evidence indicates that after Law 2258-VIII took effect on 2018-10-01 this function moved to the auditor register (now held by APOB). The historic NBU list (e.g. постанова v0640500-08 on diagnostic-survey audit firms) survives only as archival legislation.

result.result_summary: No live NBU-maintained bank-auditor register found; eligibility is determined by Section IV of the APOB register instead.

why_it_matters: Prevents the collector from wasting cycles hunting a bank.gov.ua auditor list, and pins APOB as the single eligibility authority for A1 verification.

description: No central Ukrainian repository of auditor transparency reports (звіти про прозорість) was found. Each audit entity self-publishes its Art.37 report on its own website at its own URL pattern and cadence (PwC, KPMG, EY, Grant Thornton, SOVA-Audit all differ).

result.result_summary: Transparency reports are discoverable only firm-by-firm; APOB publishes registers and inspection results but was not observed to host a transparency-report index.

why_it_matters: Collection must be driven from the APOB Section IV firm list outward to per-firm websites, which is fragile and needs per-firm URL rules plus dead-link handling.

description: Deloitte Ukraine's Ukrainian-language звіт про прозорість was referenced in search summaries as existing for 2024, but no direct PDF/landing URL was surfaced in this pass; only impact report, management report and financial-statements pages were located.

result.result_summary: Deloitte transparency-report URL unresolved; recorded as unverified, not absent.

why_it_matters: Deloitte is a significant Ukrainian bank auditor; a missing transparency report leaves a hole in the auditor→bank mapping for its clients.

description: The APOB register search interface (register.apob.org.ua) was not machine-inspected in this pass, so it is unknown whether it exposes a JSON/API endpoint, supports filtering to Section IV only, or requires JS rendering.

result.result_summary: Register access mechanics unverified; the data.gov.ua dataset is the safer bulk fallback.

why_it_matters: Determines whether auditor eligibility can be joined programmatically or must be re-derived from periodic open-data dumps.

description: English-language coverage of this cell is thin: APOB offers ?lang=en URLs but content is largely Ukrainian; transparency reports are predominantly Ukrainian-only (EY published Ukrainian versions; no consistent English series was found for the Ukrainian member firms).

result.result_summary: English-only collection would miss almost the entire cell.

why_it_matters: Confirms mandatory uk-language pipeline with Ukrainian-language OCR/NLP for PDF parsing.

description: No IFI project disclosure source was found that is specifically about Ukrainian PAYMENTS infrastructure (acquiring, card schemes, instant payments, POS) as opposed to bank lending. IFC advisory on credit reporting and EBRD TC with the NBU on financial-sector strategy are the closest, and both are credit/regulatory rather than payments-market disclosure.

result.result_summary: Searches across IFC, EBRD, EIB and WB surfaced overwhelmingly SME-lending, guarantee and risk-sharing facilities; payments appears only incidentally inside broader financial-sector programmes.

why_it_matters: For a payments-sector intelligence workstream, IFI disclosure will under-serve the payments half of the cell and must be complemented by NBU and scheme-level sources handled by other cells.

description: No Ukrainian-language mirror of IFI project-level disclosure databases was found. EBRD PSDs, IFC SIIs, MIGA project briefs and World Bank project documents for Ukraine bank transactions appear in English only; Ukrainian-language coverage comes from government republication (MoF, NBU MEFP translations), partner-bank pages and media, not from the IFIs' own registers.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian queries returned MoF/NBU/KMU pages, bank programme pages, Wikipedia and press (ZN.ua, Forbes.ua, Ekonomichna Pravda) rather than any uk-language IFI project register.

why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring of this cell must target the Ukrainian intermediaries, not the IFIs; entity resolution needs a maintained ЄБРР/МФК/ЄІБ/БАГІ/МБРР alias table.

description: The EBRD project search interface applies filters client-side rather than through URL query parameters, so there is no stable deep-link for 'Ukraine + Financial Institutions + last 12 months'.

result.result_summary: Direct fetch of the EBRD projects portal showed a filter UI (country, sector, status, document type, date range) but 'dynamic filtering through the interface rather than URL parameters'.

why_it_matters: Automated EBRD collection needs a headless browser or an undocumented backing JSON endpoint; naive HTTP scraping will silently return unfiltered or empty results.

description: openaid.gov.ua was found as the Ukrainian aid-transparency register but its current data coverage and update cadence were not established, and it was reached over plain HTTP.

result.result_summary: Only an 'About' page surfaced; described in secondary sources as a promised portal covering all IFI/donor-supported projects.

why_it_matters: It could be either the best Ukrainian-language crosswalk for IFI project names or an abandoned portal; must be verified before being relied on.

description: The cell brief anticipates 'financial covenants' in IFI disclosure. No public IFI document was found that reproduces bank-level financial covenants (capital, NPL, liquidity triggers) for a Ukrainian bank borrower.

result.result_summary: PSDs/SIIs disclose instrument type, size, use of proceeds, ownership and E&S category, but covenant schedules sit in unpublished loan agreements. IMF programme documents give system-wide prudential benchmarks, not counterparty covenants.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-promising covenant-level intelligence from this cell; the realistic ceiling is transaction structure plus system-level prudential conditionality.
